title: The doc comment on recover_interrupted_sessions says boot moves sessions to Idle and drains queued prompts; it sets Error and keeps them
outcome: The doc comment on StateInner::recover_interrupted_sessions (src/state_boot.rs) and the matching line in the src/app_boot.rs header describe what boot does: local Active, Approval and Stopping sessions become Error, pending interactions are marked Interrupted, running commands fail, one restart notice is added, and queued prompts are kept and not dispatched.
acceptance: The doc comment on recover_interrupted_sessions says boot moves sessions to Idle and drains queued prompts; it sets Error and keeps them is done
